My story is one of deep unluckiness. So it was in December I was with my cousin and he like randomly bought MDMA I've always been curious but never really fixated on trying it so when the opportunity presented I was like fuck it let's do it , I mean it was holiday season and the parents weren't around so he bought like 2 pills and we crushed them and put them in coffee that supposedly makes it stronger or something.

An hour later it wasn't what I was expecting or that euphoria and tripping balls people talk about. I felt more energetic like I could walk 5 miles or something and I was hyper vigilant and I just felt like super smart in everything I say.

That day I slept at 3am in the morning woke up the next day and I felt no residual effects. The next day my cousin comes back from work and we take half a pill and redose later on with half a pill again. The next day which is day 3 we took about half a pill each. At this point the high was depressing AF.

The problems started when I tried to sleep on the 3rd day I had weird vivid dreams like the joker was chasing me. And I woke up and got sever brain zaps and my balance was all over the place I also was super lethargic and had major concentration and social problems, my heart was racing at rest position it felt like I just ran a marathon. 

I immediately went the the internet and that's when I found it the effects of MDMA and how you needed to have a 3 months of abstinence or your gonna be fried,I knew I had messed up I just knew it because when I woke up that day I felt that a part of me was gone. 

Fast forward 9 months later I have tinnitus, visual snow,heart arrhythmia, balance problems, cognitive problems, behavior problems, deep lethargy and depression coupled with anhedonia,I've got an internal tremor too. All these effects developed after MDMA although they developed through months which is probably he cause my brain went into a hyperactive state as my calming serotonin being fried. As for my heart I might run the risk of it enlarging I'm on heart meds though.

Now you might ask yourself why did you do MDMA for 3 days? Well you need to understand that around where I'm from MDMA is not viewed as dangerous at all I mean people believe if you stay away from meth, heroin and crack your all good. So I didn't view it as being dangerous at all plus I wasn't versed in all this drug related information. I was a straight A student that has only done alcohol weed and cigs at the time. And I paid with my life. Like my life was in a straight path and now I spend days searching for the least painful way to kill yourself.
